notes.title: Hotfix 1.01
notes.notes:
Hotfix 1.01 is now live!
This hotfix focuses primarily on optimization, including the implementation of NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation. 



Additionally, we’re preparing to release an update across all platforms soon, addressing many of the most frequently reported issues.



Thank you for your feedback, patience, and support!

METAL EDEN Team.

notes.title: Metal Eden Demo patch 0.3
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who jumped into the METAL EDEN PC demo over the past weeks.
Your feedback helped us tune performance, fix audio issues, improve localization — and overall get the game into better shape for launch. We’ve updated it with new improvements like refined controller settings, sound volume controls (now adjustable by 1%), improved performance and the option to change difficulty during gameplay. We’re incredibly grateful for the support — and we hope to see you in the full game.
– Reikon Games

 

Demo Patch Notes (PC)

Overall performance optimizations for smoother gameplay

Collision issues resolved across multiple areas

Demo now ends in prologue

Audio fixes implemented for better sound quality

Polish translation improved with more accurate localization

Enhanced controller settings for better input customization

Sound volume adjustment refined — now adjustable in 1% increments

New feature: Difficulty level can now be changed during gameplay

notes.title: METAL EDEN’S NEW STORY TRAILER AND RELEASE DATE INCOMING
notes.notes:
METAL EDEN launches on September 2! The wait is almost over, and we can’t wait for you to experience the full game. 



HYPER UNITS, DIVE DEEP 

Alongside this announcement, we’ve dropped a brand-new story trailer, revealing ASKA’s origin and her mysterious link to the devastating Erosion Bomb. 

This is your first deep look into the emotional core of METAL EDEN—a world on the edge, where memories are weaponized, and nothing is what it seems. 

Who she was before—and what she must become now—are central to the journey that awaits you. 



NEXT MISSION: LAUNCH 

Now is the perfect time to lock your gear. Until then, watch the trailer, wishlist the game, and get ready to deploy!

notes.title: Metal Eden Demo Patch 0.2
notes.notes:
Hyper Units,

Thank you for playing our demo during Steam Next Fest!

We really appreciate the feedback you gave during the event and as a thank you we have a little surprise for you – we’re releasing patch 0.2 today!

This update addresses several of the most frequently reported issues based on your feedback. 

 

PATCH 0.2 SUMMARY

Performance boost: 

Reduced memory usage

Faster loading

Smoother streaming

Improved visuals

 

Combat rebalanced: 

Adjusted weapon damage and ammunition counters

Rebalanced enemy health and damage values

Modified upgrade pricing

Improved enemy aiming behavior

Updated the 'Armor Opening' mechanic to feature extended duration and increased damage output

Overhauled health restoration functionality at checkpoints

 

New mission objective system: 

Clearer HUD tracking with primary and secondary goal display

 

UI & controls overhaul: 

Better keybinding support

Upgrade stat previews

Improved menu navigation



 Bug fixes: 

Crashes

Zipline issues

 

FULL PATCH NOTES – BUILD 114404

 

⚡ Performance & Technical Optimizations 

Reduced texture sizes and improved compression (memory savings)

Decreased VFX intensity and decal lifetimes (especially explosions and smoke)

Cut down on shader compilation times and deferred heavy sequences

Navmesh, collision, and geometry fixes across multiple zones

Disabled ray tracing and heavy post-processing effects

 

🧭 New Gameplay Systems


Mission Objective Hierarchy Overhaul 

UI upgrade: Primary and secondary mission objectives now display as a clear hierarchy on the HUD and summary screen

Improved clarity for players tracking complex missions


Reworked Controls & Input Mapping 

Added support for unassigned actions with new warning prompts

 

⚖️ Gameplay Balance & Mechanics


Global Combat Tuning 

Checkpoint Health Restoration: Health recovery at checkpoints has been overhauled to scale with difficulty level. For example, on EASY, players receive full health restoration, while on BRUTAL, no health is restored.

Armor-Opening Mechanic: The duration of the armor-opening state has been increased, and weapons now deal significantly more damage during this window.

Difficulty-Based Balance Pass: A comprehensive balance update has been applied across all difficulty levels, including adjustments to weapon and enemy damage, ammunition counters, resource values, PigShop upgrade prices, improved enemy aiming behavior, and various other gameplay parameters.


Pistol SmartMod Update 

The SmartMod logic has been overhauled. It's now more streamlined and does not require locking.

 

Enemy AI Overhaul 

Enemies now predict player movement more accurately based on difficulty

Improved rotation speed when using skills

Fixes to enemies missing shots from behind and stepping incorrectly


Critical Health Behavior 

Updated logic for triggering low-health HUD effects and damage feedback

Adjusted visual/audio cues for when players reach critical HP


Checkpoint Logic Improvements 

Smarter respawn logic based on difficulty and progress

Health restoration at checkpoints now varies per difficulty level

 

🧱 Level Updates & World Optimization


Environment Optimization 

Reduced asset memory via Nanite implementation and triangle reduction

Lowered use of high-poly assets and removed excessive VFX in combat areas

Streaming tweaks to minimize pop-in and reduce load hitches

New fall respawn volumes added to prevent softlocks

Streaming bugs and crashes in multiple levels have been resolved

 

🎧 Audio & Dialogue


New Audio Mix Pass 

Reworked ambient layers, enemy effects, and spatial cues

Improved cutscene volume balancing and environmental audio dynamics


Sound Optimization 

Issues with overlapping VO and sound priorities in sequences resolved

 

📦 User Interface & UX


Shop and Weapon UI Enhancements 

Upgrades now display stat changes using color indicators (green/red)


New Option Menu Features 

Reset-to-default button for controls

Descriptions of difficulty levels have been added


HUD & Objective Enhancements 

New visual markers and logic for mission guidance

Enhanced summary screens for quest and objective tracking

 

🐞 Bug Fixes (Highlights)


Fixed crashes related to: 

Zipline interactions

Enemy rendering

Shaders and asset streaming


Fixed major gameplay bugs: 

Explosive barrels not reacting to secondary fire

Cutscene black screens and subtitle desync

Quest journal not triggering correctly

notes.title: Metal Eden Demo Patch 0.1
notes.notes:
Hyper Units,
We've just released the first patch for the demo on Steam!
This update addresses several of the most frequently reported issues based on your feedback. Thanks so much for taking the time to share your thoughts with us.
Some issues – like shader-related stuttering – are still on our radar and will be tackled in the next patch. We appreciate your patience as we continue improving the experience!

Note: This update will wipe all existing save files due to system changes.

Key Highlights

 Added a Motion Blur toggle in Video Settings.
 New options for Mouse Acceleration and Controller Acceleration are now available in the Options Menu.

Performance

 General optimization passes applied, resulting in improved performance in CRASH COURSE and PARADISE LOST
 Added support for Hardware RTX and introduced a Framerate Limit setting

Audio

 Updated audio mix for enemy sound effects, UI feedback, and player weapons.
 Final cutscene audio added for CRASH COURSE.
 Replaced an old VO line for Nexus in CRASH COURSE with a new one.
 Improved dialogue system to ensure proper voiceover triggering.

User Interface

 Translation fixes applied across various languages.
 Fixed an issue where loading screen cutscenes wouldn't always play when starting a mission.
 Subtitle settings now correctly apply to loading screen cutscenes.
 Added an "Apply Settings" button in the Options Menu.

Bug Fixes

 Resolved respawn issues after falling off the map in PARADISE LOST.
 Fixed collision bugs across multiple maps.
 Fixed the quest objective "Find Defunct Hyper Unit" completing prematurely after the core tutorial.
 Corrected objective marker placement at the end of CRASH COURSE.
 Adjusted timing in the Core Tutorial to potentially fix the infinite slow-mo bug.

Known Issues – Targeted for Next Patch 0.2

 Further improvements to game stability
 Options menu needs a clearer layout and improved usability.
 Cutscene audio is too quiet and requires proper mastering.
 Further optimization is needed to improve overall performance.
 Weapon sounds and music lack impact; audio mix will be refined.
 Gamepad keybinding support is currently missing and will be added.
 Additional improvements to overall rendering quality are in progress.

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve decided to move the release of METAL EDEN to Summer 2025. 

After going through the feedback from the demo, we saw some clear areas where we can improve. We’re taking a bit more time to refine the game and make sure it delivers the experience we’re aiming for. Your input has been a big part of that process, and we appreciate it.

We know delays aren’t ideal, and we really appreciate your patience. We’ll share the new date as soon as we can—and we’re confident it’ll be worth the wait.

Thanks for sticking with us. 
More soon.

The METAL EDEN Team
